outputs.explanation: The lower graph in panel A is a bar chart showing mean ± SD of HMGB1 signal intensity (Nuc/Cyto) across genotypes (N=4, n>100 cells), but only bars with error bars are shown, without overlaid individual data points.
The lower graph in panel B is a bar chart of % aggregate-positive Purkinje cells (mean ± SD, N=4 mice, n>400 cells) shown only as bars with error bars, without individual data points overlaid.
Panel C is a western blot image, not a plot, so the individual-data-points check does not apply.
Panel D is a line plot (time on rotarod across weeks), a plot type exempt from requiring individual data point overlays.
Panel E consists of line plots across days at different weeks, exempt from requiring individual data point overlays.
Panel F is a Kaplan-Meier survival curve (a line plot), exempt from requiring individual data point overlays.
Panel G contains only micrograph images, not a plot, so the check does not apply.
Panel H shows two bar charts (molecular layer thickness and Purkinje cell number) reporting mean ± SD for N=3 experiments/n=9 mice per group, but no individual data points are overlaid on the bars.
